What happens on the call

Two hours. Your whole year.

We build it together, one piece at a time, with time on the clock for each. You leave with your plan done.

  1. Score the five areas of your life: faith, family, health, mind and work.
  2. Score your business part by part and find the one thing to fix first.
  3. Put your year on the calendar: date nights, family trips and rest go on first.
  4. Set your 2027 numbers: revenue, profit and the hours you want to work.
  5. Commit to it out loud.

Any good movie, any good book has something that needs to be accomplished by a date. If they needed to destroy the Ring but it didn't need to happen for a hundred years, no one's going to watch that movie. Your year is the same. It needs a sentence, a date and a score.

If you can't take time away from the business, it's not a healthy business. You're building yourself a job.

Questions

Before you grab a seat.

Who is this for?

Christian business owners who are working hard and want next year to have a plan, clear numbers and weekly actions, with their family and health on it first.

Will I actually finish my plan on the call?

Yes. Every level has time on the clock to do the work, not just hear about it. You leave with it done.

What do I need to bring?

A laptop, Zoom, the workbook we send you, and a rough idea of this year's numbers. Bring your spouse if you plan together.

What if I can't make it live?

You get lifetime access to the replay. Live is better, because we build it together, but the replay walks you through every level.

Is this a sales pitch?

No. It's two hours of building your plan. If you want help running it in 2027, I'll tell you how at the end.
